name: @publishhub/api
description: PublishHub API gateway: validates publish requests, enqueues jobs, and serves post state.
//engines: Node 24, matching the pinned base image in Dockerfile and the interpreter in docker-compose.yaml. The floor is set by two things in the tree below, not by taste: dd-trace 6.x declares engines >=22, and package-lock.json is npm 11 shaped, which `npm ci` can only read from npm 11 — the npm 10.x that ships with Node 20 and Node 22 rejects it.
//dependencies: Versions are pinned exactly, with no ^ or ~ range, so a build today and a build in six months resolve the same tree (Requirement 6.6). Upgrades are a deliberate commit.
